title: Kawkhantï apnaqirin tukusiñapajj jan uñjatäkäna uka reino
intro: Sarnaqäwix kunayman apnaqirinakaruw uñt’awayi, ukampis juk’anikiw aka dominio ukar uñtasit mä dominio kamachipxäna. Kawkhantï thayajj jupanakan kamachipar istʼkäna ukat jan jiwir nayrajj amuktʼat trabajir uñjirïpkäna uka cheqanjja, uka apnaqäwejj janiw nayras ni qhepatsa utjkänti. Ukampis jachʼa reinonakas tukusiñapaw wakisi, ukat aka reinojj tukusjjäna ukhajja, cheqa yatichäwijj wali altʼat chuyman cheqatwa uñstäna, janiw khitis uka reinot suytʼañ amuykänti.
clues: Tatitujajj mä jachʼa reino churawayitu, uka reinojj qollan pankanakanwa parli.
Mä awk taykatwa jachʼa yatiñanïña ukat autoridadanak katoqawayta, jupajj Diosar taqe chuyma servisaw nayratpach sarnaqäna.
Naya pachpa thayaruw kamachiyäta, uka thayasti nayan amtanakajatakix wali jayaruw saräna.
Nayranakampi jan uñjat jaqinakax nayan apnaqäwijan irnaqapxäna, muspharkañanak lurapxäna, jan uñtaskañ muspharkañanak lurapxäna.
Nayatakix cobre chullut lurat phuch’unakaw jalluntäna, mä bendicionax Allah-an ajllitanakapat sipan mayjawa.
Aka pachat sarxasax cuerpojax mä thujrump sayt’ataw qhiparäna. Kunapachatï aka oraqen mä jiskʼa animalajj uka thujru manqʼantäna ukhakiw jakʼankirinakajj pasawayjjatap amuyapjjäna.

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
